scripts.test: npm run build && lakutata run test
scripts.dev: npm run build && lakutata run dev --parallel
scripts.android: npm run sync:android && lakutata mobile run android
scripts.ios: npm run sync:ios && lakutata mobile run ios
scripts.dev:android: npm run sync:android && lakutata run dev:android --parallel
scripts.dev:ios: npm run sync:ios && lakutata run dev:ios --parallel
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npm run stage -w app -- --platform android && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npm run stage -w app -- --platform ios && cap sync ios
scripts.package:android: npm run sync:android && cap build android --androidreleasetype AAB
scripts.package:ios: npm run sync:ios && cap build ios
